author: Kusha N M
raw:
ಸ್ವಂತಿಕೆಯ ನೆರಳಿನಲಿ ಗಳಿಕೆಗಳ ಮಾಡುತಿರೆ
ವಂತಿಗೆಯ ಕೊಡಬಹುದು ಅನ್ಯರೇಳಿಗೆಗೆ
ಸಂತನಂತಲೆ ನೀನು ಮೆಟ್ಟಿಲಾಗಿರೆ ಜನಕೆ
ಸಂತತಿಯು ನೆನಪಿಡುವ ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: When you earn in the shade of your own originality,
you can give a share for the rise of others;
when you become, like a saint, a stepping-stone for people,
the generations to come will remember you, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: Earn honestly by your own gifts, share with others, and help people climb. Those who become stepping-stones for others are remembered for generations.
